## Summary of Changes
Provide a brief summary of the changes and the rationale behind them.

## Related Issues
Closes #<issue_number>

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Protocol / Spec update (Agent Data Protocol)
- [ ] UI / Design refinement

## Verification & Testing
- [ ] Unit tests added or updated
- [ ] All pytest tests passing locally (`pytest -v`)
- [ ] Linting passing (`ruff check src tests examples`)
- [ ] E2E / Browser Studio verification performed (if applicable)

## Architectural Impact & Anti-Overfitting Check
- [ ] Adheres to ADP v1.0 canonical neutral schema
- [ ] Does not introduce single-harness assumptions or token lock-in
